restaurants.name: McDonald's

picks.name: Egg McMuffin
picks.note: One of the better breakfast sandwiches anywhere.

picks.name: Hamburger
picks.note: Two of them still come in under most of the big burgers.

picks.name: McDouble
picks.note: The most protein for the calories on the burger menu.

picks.name: Chicken McNuggets, 6 piece
picks.note: Dipping sauces add up: some are over 100 calories each.

picks.name: Fruit & Maple Oatmeal
picks.note: Filling, but low in protein. Ask for it without the brown sugar.

tips: Fries and a regular soda can double the calories of a meal. Go for water, unsweetened tea or a diet drink.
Order from the regular menu instead of a meal, then add apple slices if you want a side.
Ask for no mayo or no cheese: every sandwich is made to order.

restaurants.name: Chick-fil-A

picks.name: Grilled Nuggets, 8 count
picks.note: About as lean as fast food gets.

picks.name: Egg White Grill
picks.note: Grilled chicken, egg whites and cheese on an English muffin.

picks.name: Grilled Cool Wrap
picks.note: Before dressing.

picks.name: Market Salad with grilled chicken
picks.note: Before dressing. Has nuts and granola in the toppings.

tips: Grilled nuggets have about half the calories of the breaded ones, with as much protein.
The sauces are where it adds up: one tub of the signature sauce is about 140 calories. Barbecue or buffalo are far lighter.
Swap the waffle fries for a fruit cup or the kale salad.

restaurants.name: Chipotle

picks.name: Chicken
picks.about: about 180 cal, 32 g protein a serving
picks.note: The best protein for the calories on the line.

picks.name: Steak
picks.about: about 150 cal, 21 g protein a serving

picks.name: Sofritas (braised tofu)
picks.about: about 150 cal, 8 g protein a serving

picks.name: Black beans
picks.about: about 130 cal, 8 g protein a serving
picks.note: Fiber and protein together.

picks.name: Fajita veggies
picks.note: Always worth adding.

picks.name: Brown rice
picks.about: about 210 cal, 4 g protein a serving
picks.note: Ask for half if you want room for beans.

tips: Get a bowl or a salad: the burrito tortilla alone is about 300 calories.
A solid bowl: chicken, black beans, fajita veggies, fresh tomato salsa and lettuce, with half rice.
Pick one of cheese, sour cream, queso or guacamole, not all of them.
Chips are a meal's worth of calories on their own. Share them or skip them.

restaurants.name: Subway

picks.name: Veggie Delite, 6 inch
picks.note: Add egg or double the vegetables to make it a meal.

tips: These figures are for a 6-inch sub on multigrain bread with vegetables, before cheese and sauce.
Mustard, vinegar or a little oil instead of mayo or ranch.
Ask for every vegetable. They are free and they fill the sub out.
Any sub can be made as a salad or a bowl with no bread.

restaurants.name: Taco Bell

picks.name: Bean Burrito
picks.note: A filling meatless choice.

picks.name: Cantina Chicken Bowl
picks.note: The most complete meal on the menu.

tips: Ask for anything "Fresco style": pico de gallo replaces the cheese and creamy sauces.
Two tacos and a side of black beans beats most of the big burritos.
The frozen and fountain drinks can have more calories than the food.

copycats.like: the tacos, in lettuce and not a shell

restaurants.name: Wendy's

picks.name: Chili, small
picks.about: roughly 250 to 280 cal, 15 to 19 g protein
picks.note: Beans and beef: more fiber than anything else here.

picks.name: Plain baked potato
picks.note: A far better side than fries. Go easy on the toppings.

tips: A small chili with a plain baked potato is a full meal for about the calories of one large burger.
The salads are good choices with grilled chicken. Use half the dressing packet.
A small Frosty is still a dessert: have it sometimes, not with every order.

restaurants.name: Starbucks

picks.name: Egg White & Roasted Red Pepper Egg Bites
Turkey Bacon, Cheddar & Egg White Sandwich
Rolled & Steel-Cut Oatmeal, plain
picks.note: Add the nuts for staying power; go light on the brown sugar.

tips: The drinks are where it adds up. Ask for fewer pumps of syrup and skip the whipped cream.
Brewed coffee, an Americano, cold brew and unsweetened tea are all close to zero calories.
Pair a lighter drink with something that has protein, so breakfast lasts.

copycats.like: the Egg White & Roasted Red Pepper Egg Bites
the Spinach, Feta & Egg White Wrap

restaurants.name: Panera Bread
tips: Use "You Pick 2": a cup of broth-based soup with half a salad.
Choose the apple instead of chips or the baguette as your side.
The creamy soups and the bread bowls carry far more calories than the broth-based soups.

restaurants.name: Panda Express

picks.name: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken
picks.about: roughly 300 to 340 cal, 36 to 41 g protein
picks.note: Ask for the sauce on the side.

picks.name: Broccoli Beef
picks.about: about 150 cal, 9 g protein or more

picks.name: Super Greens, as your side
picks.about: roughly 90 to 130 cal, 6 to 9 g protein
picks.note: Instead of chow mein or fried rice.

tips: Make the side Super Greens, or half greens and half rice. It saves a few hundred calories over chow mein or fried rice.
The breaded, sweet-sauced entrees (orange chicken, Beijing beef) have two to three times the calories of the vegetable stir-fries.
A bowl (one entree, one side) is usually plenty.

copycats.like: the Orange Chicken, but baked and not fried

restaurants.name: KFC

picks.name: Original Recipe chicken breast
picks.note: Take the skin off to cut the fat a lot.

picks.name: Kentucky Grilled Chicken breast
picks.note: Not sold at every location.

picks.name: Green beans, as your side
picks.note: The lightest side on the menu.

tips: Original Recipe has fewer calories than Extra Crispy.
Pick green beans or corn over mac and cheese, the biscuit or the fries.
The bowls and pot pies are the heaviest things on the menu.

copycats.like: crispy chicken tenders, but baked and not fried

restaurants.name: Popeyes

picks.name: Blackened Tenders, 3 piece
picks.note: No breading: the leanest thing on the menu.

picks.name: Red Beans & Rice, regular
picks.note: Cooked with pork for flavor.

picks.name: Green Beans, regular
picks.note: Cooked with meat for flavor.

tips: Blackened means seasoned and not breaded. Ask for it by name.
Dipping sauces add up: some are over 100 calories each.
A biscuit has about as many calories as three blackened tenders, with almost no protein.

copycats.like: the Blackened Tenders with Red Beans & Rice

restaurants.name: Dunkin'

picks.name: Wake-Up Wrap
picks.about: roughly 150 to 340 cal, depending on the filling
picks.note: Egg and cheese is the lightest; sausage is the heaviest.

picks.name: Turkey Sausage, Egg & Cheese
picks.note: A lot of protein, and a full breakfast's calories.

tips: In coffee, flavor shots are unsweetened and flavor swirls are sweetened. Ask for shots, or fewer swirls.
Skim or almond milk instead of cream trims an iced coffee a lot.
A donut is a treat, not a breakfast: pair it with something that has protein, or save it.

copycats.like: an egg and cheese Wake-Up Wrap
an egg and cheese muffin sandwich
